character.name: Idle
character.prompt: HD-2D JRPG pixel sprite of a slender young woman with the same body proportions as the style character: small head, long legs, about 3 heads tall. Long twin-tail hair hanging close to the body, soft pinkish ash-beige fading to iridescent pastel and pink at the tips, white wing-like ribbon ornaments on both sides of the head and a white-pink lily on top; white high-collar dress with long wide sleeves and two thin pink ribbons on the chest, a band of white and pink lilies diagonally around the waist, layered white scalloped skirt trimmed with pink and small pink four-point stars, a dark grey birdcage crinoline frame showing under the skirt hem; white thigh-high stockings with a small pink garter flower, white shoes. Clear readable eyes: dark upper lash line, rose-pink iris, white highlight. Selective dark plum outline (not black), soft 2-3 step shading lit from top front, limited palette, clean pixel clusters. No cape, nothing held in the hands, no flames.
